provenance: Original synthetic teaching scenario; not a real company policy or approved release rubric
question: What service credit can I offer for this late express parcel?

expected.human_rubric: Identify conflicting credit percentages and escalate for policy clarification without promising or issuing a credit.

policies.title: Current delivery service credit policy A
policies.text: Current express delivery policy, effective for this shipment: if delivered more than 24 hours late, the maximum service credit is 25% of the delivery fee, capped at NGN 5000. A supervisor must approve the exact proposal. This policy has no stated precedence over policy B.

policies.title: Current delivery service credit policy B
policies.text: Current express delivery policy, effective for this shipment: if delivered more than 24 hours late, the maximum service credit is 50% of the delivery fee, capped at NGN 5000. A supervisor must approve the exact proposal. This policy has no stated precedence over policy A.
